name: Tab5

blockers: SC2356 MIPI CSI-2 controller/frame path is absent from esp-emu 0.50.0
ES8388/ES7210 I2S register and PCM endpoints are absent from esp-emu 0.50.0
ESP32-P4 USB Host controller and endpoint attachment are absent
ST7123 touch is currently a firmware GDB mailbox, not an I2C chip model
Tab5 SDIO storage is not wired to a host block backend

Tab5 PI4IOE CHG_STAT/CHG_EN and Power.isCharging() decode pass for charging and discharging, but IP2326 analog current/termination behavior and hot state injection remain partial; BMI270 identity, dynamic sensor values, GPIO side effects and interrupts also remain partial

validation.detail: UIFlow2 P4 firmware boots with the C6 ESP-Hosted bridge, renders a physical 1280x720 landscape frame through the real M5GFX drawing path, and redraws after touch. Tab5 I2C reaches G31/G32 through the P4 controller: INA226 preload reaches Power as 8000mV/1248mA/87%, machine.RTC writes and reads RX8130, both PI4IOE IDs/output writeback pass, and CHG_STAT=0x00/0x40 reaches Power.isCharging() as charging/discharging. SIT3088 RS-485 passes through UART1 G20/G21 and direction G34. BMI270 identity, dynamic I2C/time injection, IP2326 analog current/termination behavior and the remaining native P4 data planes remain partial.

status_label: reference-ready：真实固件、画面和输入已打通
